BlockedNumber.title: BlockedNumber
BlockedNumber.description: An Indian (+91) phone number or room ID blacklisted by the signed-in user to block incoming and outgoing calls.

phoneNumber.description: Normalized Indian phone number (+91XXXXXXXXXX) or 6-digit room code.

displayLabel.description: Optional display label or caller note.

reason.description: Optional reason for blocking (e.g., Spam, Last Caller).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on updates.

AudioTranscript.title: AudioTranscript
AudioTranscript.description: An audio recording transcribed using Gemini via Firebase AI Logic.

durationSec.description: Duration of the audio recording in seconds.

languageHint.description: Optional language label such as English / Hindi / Hinglish.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on updates.

CallLog.title: CallLog
CallLog.description: A user-scoped VoIP call history record persisted in Cloud Firestore.

CallRoom.title: CallRoom
CallRoom.description: Temporary 6-digit WebRTC signaling room shared between an authenticated Host and Caller.

IceCandidate.title: IceCandidate
IceCandidate.description: A WebRTC ICE candidate exchanged inside an active CallRoom.

/users/{userId}/blockedNumbers/{entryId}.description: User-scoped list of blocked Indian phone numbers and room IDs.

/users/{userId}/transcripts/{transcriptI.description: User-scoped history of Gemini microphone audio transcriptions.

/users/{userId}/callLogs/{logId}.description: User-scoped history of VoIP calls with duration, voice preset, and caller number.

/callRooms/{roomCode}.description: Ephemeral 6-digit WebRTC signaling room for SDP offer/answer exchange.

/callRooms/{roomCode}/candidates/{candid.description: WebRTC ICE candidates for an active 6-digit call room.
